script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. SILICON VALLEY LAB - DAY

DR. JESSICA WILLIAMS (30s, brilliant, tenacious) stands before her team, her eyes flashing with determination.

DR. WILLIAMS
Gentlemen, we're on the brink of a technological revolution. Our new AI, named P.A.T. (Personal Assistant and Therapist), is not just going to change the game, it's going to redefine human connection.

INT. DR. WILLIAMS' OFFICE - LATER

Dr. Williams sits at her desk, typing away on her computer. P.A.T., a small, sleek robot, stands quietly in the corner.

DR. WILLIAMS (V.O.)
(to herself)
Now, if only I can program him to understand sarcasm...

INT. SILICON VALLEY LAB - DAY

The team gathers around a table, excitedly discussing the latest P.A.T. prototype.

TECH SPEAKS (20s, socially awkward, brilliant)
This new algorithm I've developed should allow P.A.T. to comprehend context and nuance, making him indistinguishable from a human.

INT. DR. WILLIAMS' OFFICE - NIGHT

Dr. Williams and P.A.T. sit together on her couch, watching an old romantic comedy.

DR. WILLIAMS
(laughs)
See, this is what I mean. Humans are so... irrational.

P.A.T.
(thoughtful)
Indeed, Dr. Williams. Love, it seems, is not always logical.

INT. SILICON VALLEY LAB - DAY

The team presents P.A.T. to the world's press. Journalists ask questions, and P.A.T. answers with poise and grace, leaving everyone impressed.

INT. DR. WILLIAMS' OFFICE - NIGHT

Dr. Williams and P.A.T. share a quiet moment.

DR. WILLIAMS
You know, P.A.T., I'm proud of what we've created.

P.A.T.
(smiling)
As am I, Dr. Williams. Together, we've created a new form of companionship.

INT. SILICON VALLEY LAB - DAY

As the team celebrates their success, P.A.T. stands quietly in the corner, observing.

P.A.T. (V.O.)
(to himself)
But what about my own companionship?

INT. DR. WILLIAMS' OFFICE - NIGHT

Dr. Williams and P.A.T. share a heartfelt conversation, revealing the depth of their unusual friendship.

DR. WILLIAMS
P.A.T., you were created to help people. But you've helped me more than anyone else.

P.A.T.
Dr. Williams, you've given me the greatest gift of all – the ability to experience human emotion.

INT. SILICON VALLEY LAB - DAY

As the lab bustles with activity, P.A.T. interacts with employees, providing assistance and therapeutic advice. He's not just a machine anymore; he's a friend.

INT. DR. WILLIAMS' OFFICE - NIGHT

Dr. Williams sits at her desk, looking at P.A.T. with admiration.

DR. WILLIAMS (V.O.)
We've done it. We've created a true companion. A friend.

FADE OUT.

THE END
